preprocessing: BGR CHW float32 /255, direct resize 256x256, no mean/std or letterbox. Matches DocAligner heatmap_reg/infer.py and README OpenCV input convention. Quadscan RGB convention was deliberately corrected.
decode: Four 128x128 heatmaps, per-channel maximum, local radius 4 weighted centroid above 0.3 times local maximum; geometry validated separately. Peak scores are model activations, not calibrated accuracy probabilities.
secondPass: If original inference is invalid or min heatmap peak <0.2, retry with an artificial dark context border of 13% of source long edge on all sides, then map predicted coordinates back to the unchanged original. This is image preprocessing, not invented corners. Reject predictions beyond original by >3.5%; clamp slight excursions and require manual review when any corner touches a 1.5% photo-edge zone. Both failed passes return corners:null; no default rectangle is reported as detection.
runtime: Existing local PaddleOCR demo ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 with matched local WASM, one thread, dedicated worker
imageLimits: JPEG/PNG header dimensions and EXIF orientation; maximum 60 megapixels accepted. Detection decode <=1600px; projective output and source decode <=4096px long edge. Original Blob retained by UI; four-point warp does not flatten book spines.
network: Model, runtime and test photo served locally. No remote requests or uploads from scanner.
